name: Horror Home
description: small environment consisting of a house room, inside and outside, and one enemy

about.title: Project Overview
items: Environment: Square map featuring a forest and one safe room
Enemy: Shapeshifter enemy with detailed visual design
Focus: High-quality Level design, lighting, texturing, and visual effects

about.title: My Role
items: Conceived the map idea and transformed it into a practical design.
Created and developed the level layout, ensuring clear pathways and balanced spaces.
Organized and placed elements strategically to support the overall structure.
Implemented the map inside the engine, turning the concept into a usable level.
Reviewed and iterated on the design to deliver a polished final version.

contributions.text: Developed and implemented the level layout in Unity.
Placed environment elements and reviewed the layout through iteration.

figures.caption: Final environment: warm firelight contrasts with the blue forest and fog. This image shows lighting and composition, not a blockout or a complete route plan.

levelDesign.summary: A square forest environment with one safe room and one shapeshifter enemy. My contribution was the layout, clear pathways, spatial organization, and in-engine implementation.

cardSummary.description: A house environment with interior, exterior and one enemy.
cardSummary.contribution: Built the level layout in Unity.
